title: ThinkFlow: Self-Evolving Probabilistic Latent Memory for Lifelong Conversational Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.17010v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Lifelong conversational agents rely on memory systems to maintain deep, context-aware interactions with users. However, existing explicit textual memory pipelines suffer from a severe information bottleneck, often losing subtle behavioral patterns and emotional shifts. Furthermore, being typically static post-deployment, they cannot autonomously adapt to personal habits and preferences without manual feedback. Cognitive science, however, suggests that humans maintain mental models purely in a latent space and continuously refine them through predictive coding. Inspired by this, we propose \textbf{ThinkFlow}, a novel end-to-end latent memory framework for lifelong conversational agents. ThinkFlow bypasses the text bottleneck by dynamically compressing conversational flows into probabilistic latent memory skills, autonomously consolidating complex user states into disentangled, continuous vectors without semantic interference. translated_title: ThinkFlow：面向终身对话智能体的自进化概率潜在记忆
translated_abstract: 终身对话智能体依赖记忆系统来与用户保持深度、情境感知的交互。然而，现有的显式文本记忆流水线存在严重的信息瓶颈，常常丢失细微的行为模式和情感变化。此外，这些流水线在部署后通常是静态的，在没有人工反馈的情况下无法自主适应用户的个人习惯和偏好。然而，认知科学表明，人类纯粹在潜在空间中维持心理模型，并通过预测编码不断对其进行修正。受此启发，我们提出了ThinkFlow，一种面向终身对话智能体的新型端到端潜在记忆框架。ThinkFlow通过将对话流动态压缩为概率性潜在记忆技能来绕过文本瓶颈，自主地将复杂的用户状态整合为解耦的、连续的向量，且不会产生语义干扰。为了突破……
tldr: ThinkFlow提出了一种受人类认知科学启发的端到端潜在记忆框架，通过将对话流动态压缩为概率性潜在记忆技能并整合为解耦的连续向量，突破了传统显式文本记忆的信息瓶颈，使终身对话智能体能够自进化地记忆并自主适应用户的个人习惯与偏好。
en_tdlr: ThinkFlow is a novel end-to-end latent memory framework inspired by human cognitive science that dynamically compresses conversational flows into probabilistic latent memory skills, overcoming the information bottleneck of explicit textual memory and enabling self-evolving lifelong conversational agents to autonomously adapt to user habits and preferences.
